# AWS AI and ML

Generative AI and ML skills for the main agent: Amazon Bedrock models, agents, knowledge bases, and guardrails, plus AWS AI/ML service selection and SageMaker AI, with the read-only SageMaker AI MCP server.

## How it works

This is a **vertical plugin**: its skills, commands, and MCP servers attach directly to your main agent, with no sub-agent hand-off. Prefer the [`aws-sagemaker-engineer`](../../agent-plugins/aws-sagemaker-engineer) or [`aws-agentcore-engineer`](../../agent-plugins/aws-agentcore-engineer) or [`aws-solutions-architect`](../../agent-plugins/aws-solutions-architect) agent plugin when you want an isolated specialist instead.

- Install: `claude plugin install aws-ai-ml@talkops-devops-plugins`
- Skills activate from their descriptions; invoke one explicitly with `/aws-ai-ml:<skill>`

## Skills

| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| `amazon-bedrock` | Builds generative AI applications on Amazon Bedrock. |
| `aws-ai-ml` | Selects, deploys, and customizes AI models on Amazon SageMaker. |

## Commands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/aws-ai-ml:bedrock-app` | Design a generative AI feature on Amazon Bedrock |
| `/aws-ai-ml:choose-ml-service` | Choose the right AWS AI/ML service for a use case |

## MCP servers

Declared in [`.mcp.json`](./.mcp.json); started when the plugin is enabled and available to the main agent.

| Server | Transport | Launch | Tool names | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `aws-mcp` | stdio | `uvx mcp-proxy-for-aws-cli==1.7.0` `--skip-auth --metadata` | `mcp__plugin_aws-ai-ml_aws-mcp__*` | Managed AWS MCP Server via the toolkit's pinned proxy (aws___call_aws, aws___search_documentation, aws___retrieve_skill, ...). |
| `sagemaker` | stdio | `uvx awslabs.sagemaker-ai-mcp-server@latest` | `mcp__plugin_aws-ai-ml_sagemaker__*` | Read-only by default. Add --allow-write / --allow-sensitive-data-access to enable mutations. |

AWS credentials are inherited from the host environment (`AWS_PROFILE`, SSO, or instance role). `AWS_REGION` defaults to `us-east-1` when unset. Toggle any server off per project in `/mcp`.
